payload.title: Blob storage: filesystem/object-storage driver, derivatives, quotas, lifecycle
payload.description:
Blob bytes live in SQLite today; FRICK_BLOB_STORAGE_PATH is parsed but unused (operations.md:59; status.md). This was explicitly scoped OUT of FR-4.

Scope:
- Filesystem blob driver (then object-storage/S3-compatible) wired through FRICK_BLOB_STORAGE_PATH, with multi-tenant isolation.
- Blob processing pipeline: derivative extraction (thumbnails/transcodes), MIME/size validation, moderation hooks, orphan-cleanup jobs (hardening spec:666-706).
- Per-user blob quota + quota-aware listing (reads assert ownership today, but there's no quota) (threat-model.md:191-192).

Target: durable external blob storage with derivatives, quotas, and lifecycle cleanup.
